# `reach-class` content schema

<!-- Generated by pnpm content:docs from the "reach-class" schema in src/content/registry.ts; do not edit. -->

One JSON file per entry in `src/content/data/reach-class/`. Fields marked "required" must be present;
every other field takes the default shown when omitted ("—" = stays absent).

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | id | required | Unique table id; the game reads "reach-classes". |
| `notes` | string | required | Where the numbers come from (bead, tuning status). |
| `metres` | object | required | Reach in metres per class, strictly increasing. |
| `metres.close` | number > 0 | required | Close: a bite, a shove, a bash. |
| `metres.short` | number > 0 | required | Short: daggers and maces. |
| `metres.medium` | number > 0 | required | Medium: swords. |
| `metres.long` | number > 0 | required | Long: spears and halberds. |
| `wallRecoil` | object | required | The wall recoil rule (mw-e04.15). |
| `wallRecoil.ticks` | integer > 0 | required | Ticks the fighter is locked out of acting after clanging off a wall. |
| `wallRecoil.reaches` | list of `"close"` \| `"short"` \| `"medium"` \| `"long"` | required | Reach classes whose horizontal swings recoil when the blade meets a wall in the first half of its active window, before it strikes a creature. Vertical and thrust swings never recoil. |
